basic_info.description: 1906-1908 Folsom Street presents an exceptional opportunity for developers and contractors. This vacant apartment building consists of 6 2bd units, offering a blank canvas for a transformative renovation. The property is ready for a full rehabilitation, making it an ideal project for those looking to restore classic San Francisco building. With no existing tenants, the building allows for immediate access and streamlined  construction timelines. The layout provides ample potential for modern upgrades while preserving the  architectural character of the original structure.  The building sits on a deep lot and features a charming backyard, perfect for creating private outdoor spaces or a shared garden area. While the property does not include parking, its prime location offers easy access to public transportation, neighborhood amenities, and some of the city's best restaurants, cafes, and cultural hotspots. Don't miss this opportunity to create a standout property in the heart of the Mission.
